companyFieldUpdates.description: Flexential operates a U.S. data-center and digital-infrastructure platform providing colocation, cloud, interconnection, data protection, and managed and professional services to more than 3,000 customers across over 20 industries. The platform reports more than 40 data centers in 18 U.S. markets, over 380 MW online or under development, and a 100+ Gbps private backbone. GI Partners has sponsored the business since acquiring Peak 10 in June 2014 and completed a continuation-vehicle recapitalization in August 2025. Morgan Stanley Infrastructure Partners joined GI as a common-equity co-control owner in November 2024; their exact percentages and MSIP's fund and acquisition vehicle are not publicly disclosed.
